column1: # Ash Jenna confronts the party in Tolbi after Colosso.

column3:
You made it to Tolbi.
I knew you'd keep
chasing them.{page_break}Have you decided
what their lives
are worth, Isaac?{end_wait}
We know what you want.\nWhy are you here?{end_wait}

The next beacon may
burn before you catch
them.{page_break}I saw the beacons
burn in my world.
I won't beg this time.{end_wait}
You keep blaming him.\nWhere's your proof?{end_wait}
I don't need a jury.\nIf people stand in\nmy way, they die.{end_wait}
You'd kill anyone\nwho stood in your way?\nEven innocents?{end_wait}
Your hands shook after\nthe Manticore, Mia.\nDid you want more?{end_wait}
My own anger.\nI told my friends.\nThey stayed with me.{end_wait}
You told them?\nHow trusting.\nRemember that feeling.{end_wait}
Leave Mia out of it.\nWe're done listening.{end_wait}
You agreed to help.\nDon't imagine you\ncan choose the cost.{end_wait}
You refused me.\nBut you'll still\nhave to choose.{end_wait}
